title: Bread & pastries
blurb: Breads, French pastries, cakes and the Hong Kong bakery classics, by name and look.

groups.name: Breads of the world
groups.intro: The loaves and flatbreads you'll see in bakeries and on menus.

items.name: Baguette
items.what: Long, thin French loaf with a crackly crust and airy inside.

items.name: Sourdough
items.what: Tangy, chewy loaf with an open crumb, risen with a wild-yeast starter.

items.name: Ciabatta
items.what: Flat, airy Italian 'slipper' loaf.

items.name: Focaccia
items.what: Olive-oil-rich Italian flatbread, dimpled and topped with rosemary and salt.

items.name: Brioche
items.what: Rich, soft, golden French bread made with butter and eggs.

items.name: Bagel
items.what: Dense, chewy ring-shaped roll, boiled then baked; New York's with cream cheese and lox.

items.name: Pita
items.what: Round pocket flatbread of the eastern Mediterranean.

items.name: Rye bread
items.what: Dense, dark, sour bread, everyday in Germany and Scandinavia.

items.name: Shokupan
items.what: Fluffy, cloud-soft Japanese milk bread, sold in tall square loaves.

items.name: Tortilla
items.what: Thin round flatbread of corn or wheat, the base of tacos and burritos.

groups.name: French pastries
groups.intro: The viennoiserie and pâtisserie in every Paris window.

items.name: Croissant
items.what: Flaky, crescent-shaped laminated pastry.

items.name: Pain au chocolat
items.what: Rectangular croissant pastry wrapped around two sticks of chocolate (called chocolatine in the south-west).

items.name: Éclair
items.what: Long choux bun filled with cream and topped with shiny icing.

items.name: Mille-feuille
items.what: 'Thousand leaves': layers of puff pastry and cream under a marbled icing top.

items.name: Macaron
items.what: Pastel almond-meringue sandwich biscuits; Ladurée and Pierre Hermé are the famous names.

items.name: Madeleine
items.what: Small shell-shaped butter sponge cake.

items.name: Canelé
items.what: Small Bordeaux cake with a dark caramelised crust and custardy centre.

items.name: Paris-Brest
items.what: Ring of choux pastry filled with praline cream, shaped like a bicycle wheel.

items.name: Tarte Tatin
items.what: Upside-down caramelised apple tart.

items.name: Kouign-amann
items.what: Breton pastry of buttery, sugary, caramelised layers.

groups.name: Cakes & sweets of the world
groups.intro: Cakes and sweet bakes people name-drop.

items.name: New York cheesecake
items.what: Dense, creamy baked cheesecake on a biscuit base.

items.name: Basque cheesecake
items.what: Crustless cheesecake with a burnt, almost black top, from La Viña in San Sebastián.

items.name: Cinnamon roll
items.what: Swirled bun with cinnamon sugar; Sweden's kanelbulle is the fika classic.

items.name: Cannoli
items.what: Sicilian crisp fried pastry tubes filled with sweet ricotta.

items.name: Sachertorte
items.what: Vienna's dense chocolate cake with a layer of apricot jam.

items.name: Apple strudel
items.what: Paper-thin Austrian pastry rolled around spiced apples.

items.name: Castella
items.what: Moist Japanese honey sponge cake from Nagasaki, sold in long bars.

items.name: Doughnut
items.what: Fried dough ring, glazed or filled.

groups.name: Hong Kong bakery
groups.intro: The buns and tarts in every Hong Kong bakery window, in English.

items.name: Pineapple bun
items.what: Sweet bun with a crackly, sugary top that looks like pineapple skin (no pineapple inside).

items.name: Cocktail bun
items.what: Sweet bun filled with buttery coconut, topped with sesame.

items.name: Egg tart
items.what: Glossy yellow custard in shortcrust or flaky pastry.

items.name: Wife cake
items.what: Flaky round pastry with a sweet winter-melon filling.

items.name: Mooncake
items.what: Dense Mid-Autumn pastry stamped with characters, filled with lotus paste and salted egg yolk.

items.name: Hong Kong-style French toast
items.what: Thick peanut-butter toast, egg-dipped and fried, topped with butter and syrup.
